description: Commission of Elections  - Elected Mr. Mahamarakkalage Berty Ishan Suranga Perera as a member of the Maratuwa Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Moratuwa Municipal Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the electoral process for replacing a deceased member, including the nomination by a political party and the official declaration of the new member. This content falls squarely under electoral processes and related administrative matters, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
